name: Stock Message For WooCommerce
author: Poodle Plugins

sections.description:
Stop losing sales when products go out of stock.

Every time a customer lands on an out-of-stock product and leaves without a way to be notified, that’s a sale you may never recover. Stock Message For WooCommerce solves this by adding a “Notify Me” waitlist to your out-of-stock products – capturing customer interest and automatically sending back-in-stock email alerts the moment inventory is replenished.

No manual work needed. Customers subscribe, stock comes back, emails go out automatically.

Why use Stock Message For WooCommerce?

  • Recover lost sales – turn out-of-stock disappointment into a future conversion
  • Zero effort fulfillment – emails fire automatically when stock status changes
  • Full customisation – style the button and email to match your brand
  • Spam protection built in – optional email verification and reCAPTCHA (v2/v3) keep your list clean
  • Works with all product types – simple, variable and grouped products all supported

Features

  • Customisable “Notify Me” button with full styling controls (colour, text, size)
  • Optional email verification to confirm subscriber addresses before adding to the list
  • reCAPTCHA v2 and v3 integration to block bot signups
  • Back-in-stock emails sent automatically when products return to stock
  • Works with simple, variable and grouped WooCommerce products
  • Subscriber management dashboard with search and filtering
  • Fully customisable email templates using product variables (name, URL, image, price)
  • Monitors both manual stock updates and WooCommerce inventory changes

How it works

  1. A product goes out of stock – your customers see a branded “Notify Me” button instead of the usual out-of-stock message
  2. Customers enter their email and optionally verify it
  3. When you restock – either manually or via inventory sync – the plugin detects the change and automatically dispatches personalised notification emails to everyone on the waitlist
  4. Customers click through and buy – job done

Perfect for

  • Stores with seasonal or limited-run products
  • Shops that frequently restock popular items
  • Any WooCommerce store that wants to retain customer interest during stock outages
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/stock-message-for-woocommerce directory, or install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings → Stock Message Settings to configure your notification button, email template, and optional reCAPTCHA keys.
  4. That’s it – the waitlist form will automatically appear on any out-of-stock product.
sections.faq:
Does this work with variable products?

Yes. The plugin fully supports simple, variable and grouped products. For variable products, the notification is tied to the specific variation that is out of stock, so customers are only notified when that exact variant (e.g. size, colour) comes back.

How do customers sign up for back-in-stock notifications?

When a product is out of stock, a customisable “Notify Me” button appears on the product page. Customers enter their email address and, if you have email verification enabled, they receive a confirmation link before being added to the waitlist.

When are the notification emails sent?

Emails are sent automatically as soon as a product’s stock status changes from “out of stock” to “in stock”. The plugin monitors both manual stock updates in the WordPress admin and programmatic stock changes made by WooCommerce or other plugins.

Can I customise the notification email?

Yes. The email template is fully customisable from the settings page. You can use dynamic variables to insert the product name, URL, image, price and more into your email content.

Is there protection against fake or bot signups?

Yes. You can enable optional email address verification (subscribers must click a confirmation link) and/or reCAPTCHA v2/v3 to prevent bot submissions.

Will this slow down my store?

No. The plugin is lightweight. The notification form and email dispatch are handled asynchronously and have no impact on your store’s front-end performance.

Can I see who has subscribed for a product?

Yes. The plugin includes a subscriber management dashboard inside your WordPress admin where you can view, search and filter all waitlist subscribers by product.

Does it work if stock is updated via a CSV import or third-party plugin?

Yes, as long as the stock update goes through WooCommerce’s standard stock management functions (which the vast majority of import tools and inventory plugins use), the notification will fire.
